OVERVIEW: LLVM TargetLibraryInfo versus SDK checker

USAGE: /usr/bin/llvm-tli-checker [options] library-file [library-file...]

OPTIONS:
  --dump-tli           Dump TLI's list of functions and whether they are available
  --help               Display available options
  -h                   Alias for --help
  --libdir=<directory> Root directory for finding library files
  --report=<value>     Level of detail to report
  --separate           Report on each library file separately
  --triple=<triple>    Target triple

Pass @FILE as argument to read options or library names from FILE.
